_about: Lines in the legal drafts that describe things that start only after the invited March test (decided 17 Oct 2026, 19:43: mark them inline without changing any words). Each passage is copied exactly from the draft. A passage marks the line (paragraph or list item) that equals it; if no line equals it, it marks the one line that contains it. A section number marks a whole section. scripts/build-legal-migration.ts fails if a passage matches no line, or more than one line without an exact match. Edit this file, not the drafts, to change what is marked.
